2608.24707.title: Lost in Speech: Trilingual Spoken Hallucination Detection Across Audio and Transcripts
2608.24707.paper_summary: While text-based hallucination detection has been extensively studied, spoken hallucination detection remains largely unexplored, particularly for low-resource languages. We present the first multilingual spoken hallucination benchmark comprising 12,013 news samples across English, Russian, and Kazakh with controlled hallucinations of three types and three severity levels. Samples comprise original articles and aligned hallucinated counterparts in text and audio. We complement the synthetic corpus with 290 fact-checked fake news items collected natively in Russian (225) and Kazakh (65), translated into the other language and rendered through the same TTS-ASR pipeline. We assess fine-tuned multilingual encoders and, in zero-shot in-context settings, multimodal decoder models on transcript-based versus direct audio processing. Transcript-based detection generally outperforms direct audio processing, with binary-task degradation for strong encoders tracking per-language ASR error. On real-world fakes, synthetic-trained detectors transfer strongly (macro-F1 0.82-0.88 on original text), while Russian provenance analysis reveals both veracity-related and model-dependent machine-style signals, quantifying a key confound in synthetic hallucination benchmarks.
2608.24707.paper_summary_zh: 雖然基於文本的幻覺檢測已被廣泛研究，但口語幻覺檢測仍然在很大程度上未被探索，特別是對於資源匱乏的語言。我們提出了第一個多語言口語幻覺基準，包含12,013個新聞樣本，涵蓋英語、俄語和哈薩克語，並控制三種類型和三個嚴重程度的幻覺。樣本包括原始文章和對應的文本及音頻中的幻覺內容。我們用290個經過事實檢查的假新聞項目補充了合成語料庫，這些項目在俄語（225）和哈薩克語（65）中本地收集，並翻譯成另一種語言，通過相同的TTS-ASR管道呈現。我們評估了微調的多語言編碼器，並在零樣本上下文設置中，對基於轉錄的和直接音頻處理的多模態解碼器模型進行評估。基於轉錄的檢測通常優於直接音頻處理，對於強編碼器，基於二元任務的性能下降與每種語言的ASR錯誤相關。在真實世界的假新聞中，合成訓練的檢測器轉移效果良好（原始文本的宏F1為0.82-0.88），而俄語來源分析揭示了與真實性相關的和模型依賴的機器風格信號，量化了合成幻覺基準中的一個關鍵混淆因素。
